description: This file defines a route component for viewing and editing a note in a notes management application. It includes server loader and action functions for fetching and updating/deleting a note, along with a React component for rendering the note editing form and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a single note for viewing/editing, requires user authentication.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles updating or deleting a note based on form data submitted.

methods.name: NoteDetailsPage
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing page with form interactions.
